'''''Operational Starfighters''''' was a [[Book/Legends|book]]. A young [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] read a copy of it while he was aboard the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] ''[[Candaserri]]'' during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
